diagnosis.plain_language: Acute bronchitis is short-term inflammation of the main air passages of the lungs, often following a respiratory infection.

medications.name: Azithromycin
medications.purpose_plain: Azithromycin is an antibiotic generally used to treat certain bacterial infections.

medications.name: Ambroxol
medications.purpose_plain: Ambroxol is a medicine that helps thin and loosen mucus in the airways.

follow_up: Review after 5 days if cough persists.
